sentences.text: A red sector usually covers a hazard, such as a shoal or reef, so if you see the light turn red, you’re standing into danger and should move back into the white sector.
The Light List gives sector boundaries in degrees true, as seen from a vessel looking toward the light, not from the light outward.
You can also use the moment a light first appears over the horizon, called bobbing a light, to estimate your distance off by comparing it with the geographic range.
